name: Brindisi (Italy)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Brindisi (a stag's head and columns on red) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Brindisi, a comune in Apulia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms were recognised by decree of the Head of Government on 10 August 1924.

features.role: Brindisi arms — stag's head and columns on red, crowned, within branches
